_note: Content for The Thesaurus's three phases (enemies_master.json bosses[0].phases). synonym_variants (phase 1, synonym_swap): clue id -> a reworded clue shown after the player's first miss. antonym_pairs (phase 2, antonym_inversion): the clue of one id is shown as 'the opposite of ...' and the other id's answer is expected, in both directions. A clue may appear in at most one pair, so a prompt never has two different right answers. archaic_spellings (phase 3, obscure_variant): the archaic spelling is the full-damage answer; the modern spelling is still accepted but deals the boss's exact-match penalty (weakness.penalty_multiplier). Every id must exist in clues_master.json.
